Main App
Build Plan Tracker
The command centre for supervisors, team leads, and unit leaders — everything happening on the floor in one view.
Main · All BUs
Timeline + WO Queue
Visualizes every production line as a horizontal timeline showing the current work order, what's next, and how much time is left — based on live labour ticket data.
  • Gantt-style timeline per resource line, scrollable across multiple days
  • NOW / NEXT / THEN work order queue for every line
  • Time left calculated from run hours and completed quantity
  • DOWN / RUN status tracked per line per shift
  • Tool, Labels, Kit readiness checks for upcoming WOs
  • Labour upload from UltiPro export — updates all lines instantly
  • TV Mode for floor display screens — auto-scaled layout
Used by: Supervisors, Team Leads, Unit Leaders
Shift Tools
Shift Handoff & Logging
At the end of every shift, one click generates a printable handoff sheet — sorted by urgency, with setup flags and notes. During the shift, supervisors log safety incidents, NC events, and downtime directly in the app.
  • Shift Handoff print page — sorted by time left, DOWN lines at bottom
  • SETUP badge on next WO when tool changeover is required
  • Safety & NC logging with severity, resource, WO, and description
  • Downtime tracking with reason and duration per line
  • Plantwide log for facility-wide events (chiller, compressor, fire alarm)
  • Shift Report modal — current shift summary at a glance
Used by: Supervisors, Safety team
Reporting & Analytics
Shift Report
History and analytics for every shift, every BU — searchable and filterable. Separate standalone app so anyone can review past performance without opening the full Build Tracker.
Reporting · All BUs
History & Analytics
Every submitted shift report is stored and searchable. Filter by BU, shift, or date range to spot trends, compare performance, and identify where hours are being lost.
  • Per-shift cards — efficiency %, units produced, hours worked, lost hours
  • Filter by BU, shift (S1/S2/S3), and date range
  • Drill into any shift — see every line's performance, notes, and downtime
  • Safety incidents and lines-down status visible per shift
  • Analytics tab — efficiency trends, top downtime reasons, best/worst days
  • BU subdivisions — Tier 1 Respiratory, Tier 1 Blades, Tier 2 DNA, Tier 2 Flex
Used by: Unit Leaders, Supervisors, Management
Reporting & Analytics
Production Report
Labour ticket data viewer for unit leaders — upload the daily labour export and instantly see efficiency, units, and lost hours broken down by resource and shift.
Labour Data · All BUs
Labour Efficiency Dashboard
Takes the daily labour ticket export from UltiPro and turns it into a clean, filterable report. Unit leaders can see exactly which lines are above or below target — by shift, by resource, or by BU.
  • Total units, hours worked, lost hours, efficiency at a glance
  • Filter by date, BU, shift, and resource line
  • By-shift breakdown — Midnights, Days, Continental
  • Per-resource table — sortable, colour-coded by efficiency vs target
  • Saved filters — LoPro, VER Molding, White Room, etc.
  • Print / Save PDF for sharing with management
Used by: Unit Leaders, Plant Manager
Planning
VER Build Plan
Weekly build plan tracking for BU Verathon — compares planned quantities vs actual production, week by week and part by part.
Planning · BU Verathon
Weekly Build Plan vs Actuals
Upload the weekly build plan from Excel and the app automatically pulls actual production from labour tickets. Instantly see which camera types and parts are on track, behind, or already done.
  • Week View — progress cards per resource, planned vs actual with % complete
  • Multi-Week View — quantities across 8 weeks per part
  • By Camera View — roll up by camera type (HDMI, QC, Miller, etc.)
  • Avg / Resource — weekly average per line for capacity planning
  • Done badges when actuals meet or exceed plan
  • Live sync — plan persists in Firebase, survives page reload
Used by: BU Verathon Leader, Supervisors
Floor Operations
Operations Apps
Three tools that replaced physical whiteboards and paper-based processes on the production floor.
Operations · All BUs
Daily Manpower
Headcount tracking across all business units — who is present, absent, or on a different assignment. Replaces the physical whiteboard at the entrance to the production floor.
  • Live headcount per BU per shift
  • Absence and reassignment tracking
  • Dashboard view with historical snapshots
  • Dark / light theme for floor display screens
Used by: Supervisors, HR, Unit Leaders
Operations · BU Verathon
Shift Assignment
Multi-BU shift scheduling tool — assigns operators to lines based on absences, training matrix, and priority. Replaces the paper-based shift setup process.
  • 4-step flow — Absent → Lines → Headcount → Assign
  • Auto mode assigns from priority list; Manual mode for supervisor control
  • Roster management with operator training records
  • Priority list — set which operators go to which lines first
  • Rotation tracking for ergonomic scheduling
Used by: Supervisors, Team Leads
Operations · BU Verathon
Shift Readiness
Pre-shift readiness audit across all Verathon production lines. Team leads complete a checklist before the shift starts — results are logged and visible to supervisors in real time.
  • Audit checklist per production line before shift start
  • Live feed — see which lines are checked in real time
  • History and analytics — track readiness trends over time
  • Config panel to manage which lines and checks are required
Used by: Team Leads, Supervisors
